text:
alice: Heads-up — draft release notes are ready for the 1.4.3 roll. Need a quick pin + announce plan for internal channels. Change window target: 02:00-04:00 UTC, Friday.
ben: Seen. Are we pinning to the rc build or safe-stable? I want the ability to roll forward if perf looks good.
alice: Pin to RC for canary, but keep the fallback to 1.4.2-stable. Pin commit: `abc1234def` (artifact: `rls-1.4.3-rc2`).
carla: I updated the RN section for the opt-in cache flags and reduced the breaking detail to a single sentence. Also added a short snippet for partner-facing notes.
dmitri: Canary plan looks good. Monitoring hooks:
- perf: endpoint P50/P95 token latency dashboards
- errors: 5xx and inference-timeout count
- quality: evaluation set `signup-flow/regression-003` run on canary traffic
If any of these exceed thresholds, we rollback.
ops-oncall: What are the exact thresholds? Need them in the announce so folks know when to ping.
dmitri: Thresholds: P95 > 1.2s OR error rate > 0.5% over 5m OR eval drift > 3% on the eval set. I'll post the runbook link in a sec.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rls-1.4.3-rc2 -> canary pool. Canary targets: 5% traffic in eu-west, 5% in us-east. Job id: DB-48291.
ben: For the internal announce, suggest we include a short rollback matrix and the command to trigger immediate rollback. Example:
```
# rollback to stable
repoint-service --model rls-1.4.2-stable --env prod
```
Also include TTL on pinning: "pin expires in 24h unless promoted" — reduces accidental long pins.
carla: I'll add a "what to watch" bullet and who to ping: @dmitri, @ops-oncall, @ben. Also a one-liner for product: "improves latency on long prompts".
alice: OK — publishing plan: internal slack blurb in #eng-releases + #product + #support 30m before window. Attach RN and rollback matrix. Add change window and contact list.
dmitri: Reminder: canary health check script (runs every 60s):
```
./canary_health_check --job DB-48291 --eval-set signup-flow/regression-003
```
If script exits non-zero, it will annotate the deploy and notify @ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: I'll be on-call for the window and will escalate to SRE lead if automated rollback doesn't kick.
alice: Final ask: thumbs up from SRE + Docs + Eng leads before we post. If no objections in 20m we push the announce draft.
carla: LGTM from docs. Minor grammar tweak pushed.
ben: LGTM from eng.
dmitri: LGTM from SRE. Will monitor.
alice: Great — I'll post the internal announce in 20. Deploy bot will do canary, team will monitor, rollback cmd is here if needed. :rocket:
